title: Bring every rule to one form
heading: Every Linear Rule Fits Ax ≤ b: Flip ≥ Rows, Split = Rows
cases: rules that are already at most a limit become rows unchanged
an at-least rule becomes one row with its coefficients and its limit negated
an exactly rule becomes two rows, the at-most row first
every one of the n variables has a column, even one no rule mentions
